title: Winter weekday peak
description: Elhub reference hour 2026-01-12T08:00:00+01:00: each price area and Elhub group at its metered demand (elhub:consumption-per-group-mba-hour; national 22883 MW), shared by its loads in proportion to their reference demand. Dispatch (rule reference-hour-dispatch): ENTSO-E measured 3312 MW wind, 2594 MW run-of-river and 150 MW gas, shared by capacity (run-of-river units below their turbine's minimum stable loading committed per price area); HVDC links and the Nordic exchange at the measured flows (net export 2147 MW); storage hydro closes the balance at one common loading; losses are left to the slack. hvdc:nordlink measured 1404 MW, scheduled at its 1400 MW rating. The Nordic remainder is at its winter-peak inertia and load.

provenance.note: winterPeak case: Kinetic energy 256 GWs (Fingrid map, 2020-12-31 17–18) × remainder share 66.9 % (Norway 6.6 % NO4 + 26.5 % southern Norway) = 171 GWs. Load: non-coincident January 2026 peaks SE 24,965 + FI 15,553 + DK2 2,616 = 43,134 MW (coincident value probably 1–2 GW lower). FCR-N 600 MW over ±0.1 Hz and FCR-D 1450 MW up / 1400 MW down for the Nordic area (2026 SOA LFCR parameters); Norway's 2026 obligation share is 38 %, so the remainder holds 62 %: FCR-N 372 MW = 3720 MW/Hz, FCR-D up 899 MW (linear 49.9→49.5 Hz), FCR-D down 868 MW. aFRR: the Nordic 2026 volume of 200 MW each way (Appendix 1 to Annex LFCR 2026) less Norway's 31 % share = 138 MW.
